revision_command.text:
Explicit implementation revision: preserve all accepted requirements, public inputs/outputs, original business operations and cleanup. Correct products_file to use a real document_write result field whose authoritative schema satisfies the accepted nonnullable string, with required success/presence assertions; do not substitute the destination literal for the writing result or remove the write.
The proposal also forwards entire Browser results directly into global interpretation and a whole search collection to a single extract. These are not bounded compaction. Revise using existing typed selection first, and independent extract each over complete producer pages where extraction is needed, with a narrow declared resultType per immediate consumer. Process every page; flatten only one declared level. Keep complete observations and exact action arguments separately. Global decisions receive only compact decision fields/IDs, with deterministic lookup to original records. Do not ask extraction to invent original indices, classifications, status values or select the first ten; original positions must come from deterministic bindings and business selection remains interpret over the complete compact candidate view. Do not flatten an unbounded record collection into mapping each; the existing 1000-item host ceiling remains.
Keep actual per-product visits, observed-value extraction, explicit missing-data handling, real workbook writing and unconditional Browser cleanup. Do not forward raw observation envelopes into interpretation or return success/empty products when observations are incomplete. Add fail-fast completeness requirements using exact producer metadata. Any entry-known operation requires under a branch must already be implied by its condition; newly observed-result checks remain runtime assertions. Preserve nullable data and exact typed branch exports; never invent selectors or action compatibility. This is a full explicit revision because compaction needs task structure changes; all requirements and budgets remain unchanged.
